meta.title: Buy the Reebok Club C 85 Vintage Shoes. (Adidas Stan Smith alternative)
meta.description:
Buy the Reebok Club C’s here! https://amzn.to/3p3VKiz

The Reebok Club C 85 sneaker! Or shoe! It's one of those things where a square is a rectangle but a rectangle isn't a square or something like that. I look at the Reebok Club C 85 as an alternative to the goat of white sneakers, the Adidas Stan Smiths. Not because they look THAT similar besides their color but just because they are something that is a little different. Although truth be told I may be a little late because it seems like a lot of people wear these sneakers...whatever though. Are they Common Projects quality? No. But tbh I don't really care.

What do I think of them? I love them. Catch me in them if you're fast enough.
